name: Game of Life
justification: Unique output; either simulate min(m,n) steps or reason about nearest-1 distances, both fiddly-ish.
solution_sketch: A dead cell becomes alive at time min(dl,dr) to the nearest initial 1, unless dl == dr (two alive neighbors, stays dead). Output 1 iff alive initially or dl != dr and min(dl,dr) <= m. Simulating min(m,n) steps also fits.
